Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_records, compound_structures, docs. Join metabolism to compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id. Join compound_records to compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Join metabolism to docs on metabolism.drug_record_id = docs.doc_id. Filter metabolism.organism = 'Canis lupus familiaris'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
